hero.tagline: Preserving Kerala’s toddy culture and culinary traditions.

story.title: Our Story
story.content: For generations, the local toddy shop (Shappu) has been the beating heart of Kerala's villages. It is where communities gather after a long day in the backwaters, where generational recipes for spicy duck roast and fiery fish curries are perfected, and where stories are shared over freshly tapped sweet toddy. We built this platform to ensure these cultural landmarks are celebrated and preserved.
